name: ANSI/IEEE Key-operated normally-closed switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of key-operated normally-closed switch: a key-operated NC switch opens its reference closed contact through the key mechanism.
description: This reference locates key-operated normally-closed switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. A key-operated NC switch opens its reference closed contact through the key mechanism. Its access and switching functions must be documented separately. The public library uses HPB12KS for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Read the reference position from the operator schedule. NC identifies the contact reference state, not a guarantee of tamper-proof control. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
